name: DUMBBELL CLOSE GRIP FLOOR PRESS
introduce:
Lie on your back with your feet flat on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in each hand. 

Raise your arms towards the ceiling with your palms facing each other and dumbbells pressed together. 

Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, then slowly push them back. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Exhale as you raise the dumbbells, and inhale as you lower them.
